summary: Frontend-only verification of (1) Header restructure with Services dropdown + Managed Services side-flyout, (2) three new Managed Services sub-pages (Oracle AMS, Infrastructure & IT Operations, Microsoft Workplace Support), (3) mobile menu nesting, and (4) regression on existing routes. All acceptance criteria pass.

design_issues.screen: Oracle AMS / Infrastructure / Microsoft Workplace pages
issues: Meta description falls back to the generic site-wide meta from index.html ('Infotron Solutions - Enterprise IT Services & Talent Solutions') rather than a page-specific description. Tags pass the acceptance criterion ('meta description present') but page-specific descriptions via Helmet would improve SEO.

action_items: OPTIONAL (not blocking): Add page-specific <Helmet><meta name='description' .../></Helmet> on Oracle AMS, Infrastructure & IT Operations, and Microsoft Workplace Support pages so each gets a unique description instead of inheriting the generic site description.
critical_code_review_comments: Header.jsx duplicates link-list markup for the Services dropdown rows; could be refactored to map over an array of {label, href, sublabel} for maintainability.

Side-flyout uses onMouseEnter on Managed Services row only; closing onMouseLeave is delegated to the wrapper. This works but consider adding a small hover-bridge timer (closeOnMouseLeaveDelay) so users with shaky cursors do not lose the flyout when transiting the gap. Currently the ml-2 gap is bridged because the wrapper still encloses both panels.

Both the Services button (data-testid='nav-services') and the Managed Services row are buttons/links, but the parent <button> for Services has no aria-haspopup/aria-expanded. Add ARIA attributes for keyboard/SR users.
Dropdown is open-on-hover only with no focus/keyboard support; dropdown is inaccessible to keyboard users. Recommend adding onClick toggle and Escape-to-close.
Pages set document.title via Helmet but reuse the global meta description. Add unique per-page meta description and og:title/og:description for shareability.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Verified on preview URL https://capital-projects-dev-1.preview.emergentagent.com. Key data-testids are stable: nav-services, services-dropdown, managed-services-flyout, mobile-services-toggle, mobile-managed-toggle, page-oracle-ams, page-infrastructure-it-operations, page-microsoft-workplace-support, oracle-hero-cta, infra-hero-cta, ms-hero-cta. Use Playwright .hover() (NOT JS dispatchEvent) on the data-testid='services-dropdown' a[href='/services/managed-services'] anchor to trigger the side flyout. Mobile menu uses click toggles. All 3 hero CTAs link to /contact?type=client&service=<slug>.
